name: Smart TTS
summary: A multilingual text-to-speech engine for screen reader users: every language is read in its own voice, automatically, with a fast built-in English voice and many reading options.
whatsNew: What's new in Smart TTS 1.3 - 205 languages on the Languages page. - Make audio file: its own speed, 0.5x to 4x. - NEW: Read and copy codes from SMS: the code is copied and said slowly, twice, wherever you are. - Reed: Phrase prediction, Backquote voice tags, Sound profile and Voice shape (head size, roughness, breathiness, pitch fluctuation, gender). - Reading: short web links, counted repeated signs, split joined words, Roman numerals as numbers, no repeated typed letters. - Numbers: codes digit by digit, Urdu and Hindi numbers in words, lakh and crore, date order. - Sound: Audio optimization, Audio routing, Low latency mode. - Keep voices running: shortcuts for battery, auto start and never pausing the app.
